content:
maria: Quick async standup — what I did: wired the microbatch orchestrator into the slot allocator and ran a smoke perf pass; saw ~12% improvement in p99 for 32-token tails. Blocker: KV warmup still not populating for a subset of long-history sessions, causing some cold-start tail spikes. Today: pushing a tiny eviction-heuristic change and need 1-2 reviews. @samir @lee can you eyeball PR #3421 when you get a sec?

samir: on it. saw the p99 drop in the dashboard too — nice. for the KV warmup: can you paste the warmup trace? wondering if prefix hashing changed.

maria: pasted below — it's clipped but shows the pattern.

```
WARMUP_TRACE session=abc123 prefix_hits=3 -> 0 after roll; keys_evicted=8 reason="score_drop"
```

lee: quick thought — our score decay constant got bumped in the kernel change last week. that could push hot prefixes below threshold during bursty traffic. if true, we should adjust decay per-model.

maria: good catch. i'll try lowering decay for the Llama-variant canary and re-run.

jia: small heads-up: I'm scheduling a 15m bench at 2pm PT (bench-run id 171700-b1) to reproduce the tail at scale. will run 1k rps steady + 200 rps microbursts. please pause canary if you need a clean baseline. @deploy-bot can you mark canary as paused at 13:55 PT if requested?

deploy-bot: noted — canary pause requests should be posted in this thread with "PAUSE_CANARY" and a timestamp. I will ack.

omar: quick blocker for me: I need the updated kernel config that enables prefetch-sampling. @maria did you push that to the config repo? I couldn't find it in infra-configs.

maria: pushed as `kernel/prefetch-sampling/v2.yaml` — small change: sample_rate=0.08 and bucket_size=64. link: https://git.internal/redwood/kernel/-/blob/main/prefetch-sampling/v2.yaml

pranav: re: batching: I saw slot steal at 14% under the new allocator in the microbench logs. can we try increasing max_batch_delay to 6ms for the canary group to see if that smooths slot utilization? small config tweak, low risk.

samir: yep, +1 for trying 6ms on canary only. reduces throughput variance but might slightly increase median. tradeoff is acceptable for tail wins.

maria: will flip canary batch_delay to 6ms after jia's bench. PR #3421 will include that flag gated by env.

lee: FYI I left comments on #3421 about a nit in the eviction metric names. not blocking.

maria: thanks — addressing now. if anyone can review before 11:30 PT that would let me roll to canary post-bench.

jia: bench scheduled, starting in 10. I'll post summary (throughput, p50/p95/p99, kv-hit-rate) after run.

omar: one last ask — can we add a quick smoke to validate that KV warmup actually increments `prefix_hits` in the first 5s after session replay? i can add the assertion to the bench harness.

maria: yes please, that would help. add `assert prefix_hits > 0 within 5s` and push to bench harness branch `bench/kv-warmup-asserts`.

pranav: tagging @lee for visibility on the slot-steal dashboard: https://redwood.internal/slot-steal/171700 — will check after bench.

samir: rough timeline: maria pushes PR -> jia runs bench 2pm -> we pause canary if noisy -> flip batch_delay & decay config -> smoke validation -> canary roll. target finish EOD.

maria: sounds good. thanks folks. I'll ping here with PR link and canary flip times. :thumbsup:
